# iFixx Remodeling & Handyman Services

> Charlotte's Trusted Handyman & Emergency Repair Services

## About

iFixx is a family-owned home services contractor serving the Charlotte, NC metro area. We provide professional handyman repairs, kitchen and bathroom remodeling, and 24/7 emergency services.

- Phone: (980) 391-6833
- Email: ifixx.hs@gmail.com
- Website: https://ifixxnc.com
- Location: Charlotte, NC
- Service Radius: 50 miles

## Services

### Home Repairs
- Carpentry
- Painting
- Drywall and ceiling repair
- Doors and windows
- Furniture assembly
- TV mounting
- Pressure washing
- Quick fixes and small repairs

### Remodeling
- Kitchen remodeling
- Bathroom remodeling
- Flooring installation
- Outdoor living spaces

### Emergency Services
- 24/7 emergency fixture repairs
- Emergency door and window repairs
- Water damage response

Note: iFixx does not offer plumbing, electrical, or HVAC services. Major plumbing, electrical panel, or in-wall wiring work is referred out to licensed specialists.
